Verified against the delivered file rather than assumed: the fix diff is 11 insertions / 0 deletions and introduces no helper, no branch, and no new abstraction that could be reduced.

security.reason: No security surface exists. The change is confined to tests/causal-rotation-consumers.spec.mjs and alters only test timeout budgets.
